module origen_091491(
    input [15:0] x,
    input [15:0] y,
    output reg [15:0] quotient,
    output reg [15:0] remainder
);

reg [15:0] q, m, temp;
integer i;

always @(*) begin
    #1;
    temp = 16'd0;
    q = x;
    m = y;

    for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin
        {temp, q} = {temp, q} << 1;
        if (temp >= m) begin
            q[0] = 1'b1;
            temp = temp - m;
        end
    end

    quotient = q;
    remainder = temp;
end

endmodule

// Testbench
module tb_division;
    reg [15:0] x, y;
    wire [15:0] quotient, remainder;

    division dut (
        .x(x),
        .y(y),
        .quotient(quotient),
        .remainder(remainder)
    );

    initial begin
        // Test case 1: 10 / 2
        x = 16'd10;
        y = 16'd2;
        #10;
        $display("10 / 2: Quotient = %d, Remainder = %d", quotient, remainder);

        // Test case 2: 10 / 11
        x = 16'd10;
        y = 16'd11;
        #10;
        $display("10 / 11: Quotient = %d, Remainder = %d", quotient, remainder);

        $finish;
    end
endmodule
